capabilities.subtitle: We specify and supply sealing systems for valves, pumps, agitators and flange joints — matched to the media, pressure and temperature on your site.
capabilities.cap1Desc: API 622 compliant graphite packings achieving under 20 ppm fugitive emissions.
capabilities.cap2Desc: Technical support for valve, pump, agitator and other dynamic and static seal selection.
capabilities.cap3Desc: Support for renewable energy, hydrogen and carbon capture applications.
capabilities.cap4Desc: Dynamic sealing rated to 650 °C and 350 bar; static sealing up to 1360 °C.
capabilities.cap5Desc: Partner-plant production with full batch traceability and quality documentation.

sustainability.subtitle: Reducing emissions, conserving energy and supporting sustainability goals through sealing that performs reliably under pressure — because every seal protects people, processes and the environment.
sustainability.c1Desc: Fewer fugitive losses at every joint
sustainability.c2Desc: Lower pressure loss and pumping demand
sustainability.note: We are building digital selection and monitoring tools to forecast seal life and support sustainable plant operation.
